name: Lift.KummerChart.JumpLattice.coeff_mem_constantsModE
summary: Strong induction on n: split s_a = w(s_a) + E·t(s_a) and f = X·divX(f) + f(0); the constant part has exponents min(1, o) at E and the invariance of constants, which improves to the claim by mem_withExponents_of_deep; for n + 1 divide the E-part by E and apply the hypothesis to t(s_a), divX(f).

steps.claim: Strong induction on n (for all s, f, o); in both cases rewrite H with s_a = w(s_a) + E·t(s_a) and f = X·divX(f) + f(0): K: Σ_a w(s_a)v_a − f(0)c + E·(Σ_a t(s_a)v_a − divX(f)(E)c) ∈ withExponents(L, i, shiftedStd(l, o)).
steps.lean:
induction' n using Nat.caseStrongRecOn with n ih generalizing s f o <;> have K := by simpa [
    add_smul, mul_smul, ← smul_sum, add_sub_add_comm, ← smul_sub, Int.cast_smul_eq_zsmul] using
    (funext (eq_add_of_sub_eq <| e <| s ·) ▸ f.X_mul_divX_add ▸ H :)
  refine ⟨?a, mem_withExponents_of_le (mem_withExponents_of_deep (lo := shiftedStd l (1 ⊓ o ·))
    ((add_mem_cancel_left (by simpa using! (frobEUnit_zpow_mem_withExponents 0 1
    (sub_mem (sum_smul_mem _ _ fun a _ ↦ (hv a).1.2) (smul_mem _ _ hc.1.2))))).1
    (mem_withExponents_of_le K)) ?a.2)⟩
  exact sub_mem (sum_mem fun a _ ↦
    ⟨smul_mem (locLetterPart ..) _ (hv a).1, fun ⟨_, γ, rfl⟩ ↦ by simpa [fixes,
    S_smul, frobGroup_smul_smul, smul_sub] using (smul_mem _ _ ((hv a).2 ⟨_, γ, rfl⟩))⟩) (by bound)
  simpa using ih _ .refl _ f.divX ((sub_one_lt _).le.trans <| ho ·) (Eq.subst (by
    simp [inv_smul_eq_iff]; rfl) (frobEUnit_zpow_mem_withExponents 0 (-1)
    (sub_mem K (mem_withExponents_of_le (ih 0 bot_le _ _ ho H).2))))

steps.claim: n = 0, d = Σ_a w(s_a)v_a − f(0)c: the E-part has exponents raised by one at E (frobEUnit_zpow_mem_withExponents 0 1), so d has shiftedStd(l, min(1, o)); with the invariance of d (proved next) mem_withExponents_of_deep gives the exponents shiftedStd(l, (0 if o(u) ≤ 0 else A)).
steps.lean:
refine ⟨?a, mem_withExponents_of_le (mem_withExponents_of_deep (lo := shiftedStd l (1 ⊓ o ·))
    ((add_mem_cancel_left (by simpa using! (frobEUnit_zpow_mem_withExponents 0 1
    (sub_mem (sum_smul_mem _ _ fun a _ ↦ (hv a).1.2) (smul_mem _ _ hc.1.2))))).1
    (mem_withExponents_of_le K)) ?a.2)⟩
  exact sub_mem (sum_mem fun a _ ↦
    ⟨smul_mem (locLetterPart ..) _ (hv a).1, fun ⟨_, γ, rfl⟩ ↦ by simpa [fixes,
    S_smul, frobGroup_smul_smul, smul_sub] using (smul_mem _ _ ((hv a).2 ⟨_, γ, rfl⟩))⟩) (by bound)

steps.claim: d ∈ constantsModE(L, l, A, i): w(s_a) ∈ Λ is fixed by Γ' (fixes), so the w(s_a)v_a and c lie in it.
steps.lean:
exact sub_mem (sum_mem fun a _ ↦
    ⟨smul_mem (locLetterPart ..) _ (hv a).1, fun ⟨_, γ, rfl⟩ ↦ by simpa [fixes,
    S_smul, frobGroup_smul_smul, smul_sub] using (smul_mem _ _ ((hv a).2 ⟨_, γ, rfl⟩))⟩) (by bound)

steps.claim: n + 1: apply the hypothesis at n to t(s_a), divX(f) and o − 1: its hypothesis holds because E·(Σ t(s_a)v_a − divX(f)(E)c) = K minus the n = 0 part (which has the exponents by the case n = 0), and dividing by E lowers the exponent at E by one (frobEUnit_zpow_mem_withExponents 0 (−1)); the coefficient n of divX(f) is f_{n+1} and t^n(t(s)) = t^{n+1}(s).
steps.lean:
simpa using ih _ .refl _ f.divX ((sub_one_lt _).le.trans <| ho ·) (Eq.subst (by
    simp [inv_smul_eq_iff]; rfl) (frobEUnit_zpow_mem_withExponents 0 (-1)
    (sub_mem K (mem_withExponents_of_le (ih 0 bot_le _ _ ho H).2))))
